scope: bounded real-public aggregate validation; no independent or clinical validation

findings.triangulation: same-source consistency and denominator arithmetic only
findings.bias: historical hospital-discharge ascertainment, missing source strata and aggregate denominator limitations
findings.equity: Indigenous status, subnational populations, people outside recorded care and actual patient/community voice are absent
findings.transportability: not estimable and no Finland-to-Australia combination performed
findings.overlap: Track 010 and 011 share the Orphadata input and are not independent
findings.uncertainty: source intervals and age/sex detail are unavailable; no uncertainty estimate asserted
findings.decision_sensitivity: any missing exact hash, rights, fitness, review or critical assurance receipt retains fail-closed activation

dissent.position: Do not call same-source reuse triangulation or use the incidence row as a burden parameter.
A denominator-only result must not be presented as coverage of Indigenous, underserved or out-of-care populations.
Keep atlas and release claims blocked until qualifying independent and rights evidence exists.
